sn36.20:1.1: mayā bhikkhave vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || tisso pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || pañca pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || cha pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || aṭṭhārasā pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || chattiṃsā pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || aṭṭhasatam pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena || || 4
sn36.20:1.3: evam pariyāyadesite kho bhikkhave mayā dhamme ye aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ na samanumaññissanti na samanujānissanti na samanumodissanti || tesam etam pāṭikaṅkham bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññam mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharissanti || ||
sn36.20:1.5: evam pariyāyadesite kho bhikkhave mayā dhamme ye aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ samanumaññissanti samanujānissanti samanumodissanti || tesam etam pāṭikaṅkhaṃ samaggā samodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññam pīyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharissanti || || 5-14
sn36.20:2.2: Ṭhānaṃ kho panetam bhikkhave vijjati yam aññātitthiyā paribbājakā evam vadeyyuṃ ||
sn36.20:2.3: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ Samaṇo Gotamo āha || taṃ ca sukhasmim paññāpeti ||
sn36.20:2.5: Evaṃ vādino bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā ||
sn36.20:2.6: Na kho āvuso Bhagavā sukhaññeva vedanaṃ sandhāya sukhasmim paññāpeti ||
sn36.20:2.7: Yattha yattha āvuso sukham upalabbhati || yamhi yamhi taṃ taṃ tathāgato sukhasmim paññāpetīti || ||
